name: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics (2023)
owner: Israel National Cyber Directorate (INCD) & Government of Israel
description: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics (December 17, 2023). National policy and strategic framework for artificial intelligence regulation, ethics, and innovation issued jointly by the Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology and the Ministry of Justice Counseling and Legislation Department.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Israel National Cyber Directorate (INCD) & Government of Israel (cyber.gov.il) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Israel National Cyber Directorate (INCD) & Government of Israel (cyber.gov.il).
